clips.title: The story
paras: In Old Town, Dashel Stonefist is known for his quick temper and heavy hands. The dwarf called Fist keeps to Stormwind City's rougher alleys, where dangerous connections draw the attention of covert investigators.

In Old Town, Dashel Stonefist is known as Fist for the street fights that have earned him the name. Locals and city guards see a drunken, combative dwarf ready to throw a punch outside a tavern. His place in the district puts him at the nexus of Stormwind's underworld, where smugglers, cutpurses, and political agitators trade coin and rumors beyond the eyes of Cathedral Square.
